report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy checkout: gateway checkout span OK at 63ms, order error rate 0.001, p95 80ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and INFO request_complete logs. No taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is substantiated. Evidence is too narrow to bound a root cause, so hand off for broader telemetry.
